ios.desc:
See every workout land on your body, with a coach's notes on every exercise.

Log a set and watch it light up a live muscle map, so you can see what you have trained, what you have missed and when you are ready to go again. Behind it sit 700+ curated exercises with setup, coaching cues and the mistakes to avoid, readiness built from your own history, and GPS runs, walks and rides in the same picture. All of it is free, with no account and no subscription. Pro adds planning that builds your next session from what you have actually done.

BUILT FOR IPHONE DUO
Open the Duo and TotalBodyIQ opens up with it: dashboard beside today's session, coaching beside your set logging, muscle data beside the body map, and your training record beside each run, lift and session. Every pane minimizes to the single view. Folded, it is the same one-handed app.

THE MUSCLE MAP
Every set you log colors the muscles it worked. See where your training is concentrated, which muscles have had less attention, and the sets, reps and weight behind the picture.

LOG WITHOUT FRICTION
Weight, reps and timed sets. Warm-up and working sets kept apart. A rest timer between sets, a session you can pause and pick up again, and your full history to look back on.

700+ EXERCISES, COACHED
Animated demonstrations for supported exercises, with setup instructions, coaching cues and the common mistakes to watch for. Search and filter by muscle and equipment, from barbell to bodyweight.

RUN, WALK, RIDE
GPS tracking with route, distance and pace or speed, stored alongside your strength sessions. Heart-rate zones, Apple Health and Bluetooth heart-rate monitors all connect in.

READINESS AND BALANCE
A readiness estimate, weekly load and muscle balance, built from your own training history, so you know when to push and when to hold back. Free, with no wearable needed.

INCLUDED FREE
• Workout logging and full history
• Muscle maps, muscle balance and readiness
• 700+ exercise guides and rest timers
• Balanced and My Plan sessions
• Workout Generator: a full-body session from your time and kit
• GPS runs, walks and rides

No subscription or wearable is needed for any of these.

TOTALBODYIQ PRO, OPTIONAL
• Smart workout planning built from your training history
• Generator focus, cardio and favorites
• Progression tracking
• Advanced statistics
• Expanded progress-photo tools

Choose monthly, annual, or a one-time Lifetime unlock. Prices and any free trial are shown in the app before you buy.
